snippet.title: The Well's Blessing - Trailer (Now Play This 2025)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3637250/The_Wells_Blessing/

A narrative-driven first-person exploration and puzzle game in which three animal-like teenagers embark on a journey of self-discovery as they wander the mystical Sanctuary of the Old Well, uncovering its history and meeting other curious visitors.

Learn more about the game on https://big-stretch.itch.io/the-wells-blessing
Our socials: https://linktr.ee/thewellsblessing
